Synopsis:
Reuters preview of the 2026 US Open women's singles final between world #1-to-be Elena Rybakina (KAZ) and defending champion Aryna Sabalenka (BLR). Sabalenka chases an unprecedented third consecutive US Open title and her fifth Grand Slam overall; Rybakina enters assured of the world #1 ranking on Monday. The article covers head-to-head dynamics, contrasting temperaments, match context, and geopolitical backdrop tied to the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
